run_sensitive_topics_evaluation_teacher: run the SensitiveTopicsEvaluationTeacher to load and serve sensitive topics evaluation data for validation
build_sensitive_topics_dataset: build the sensitive topics evaluation dataset using the build function from the build module
setup_sensitive_topics_data: setup sensitive topics evaluation data by parsing JSONL lines and yielding examples with episode flags

create_default_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance as an alias for SensitiveTopicsEvaluationTeacher to use in Parlai tasks
